## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: strong sector breadth plus broad leadership (Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5)) indicating money rotating across sectors rather than fleeing.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Real Estate lead: CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY and PLD (news +80) supporting the group; Materials strong: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY; Technology showing rotation: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Discretionary lagging: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND and HD (1W: -2.07% | 1M: -12.28%) BELOW TREND; Energy weak on the week: XOM (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +7.26%) CORRECTION and CVX (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%) CORRECTION; Communication is mixed and effectively lagging versus leaders: TMUS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: NEM (1W: +14.78% | 1M: -4.46%) RECOVERY, INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +9.94% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY, CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY, BA (1W: +7.13% | 1M: -8.40%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5), cyclical rotation evident.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -7.58% | 1M: -15.38%) BELOW TREND, UL (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -19.72%) BELOW TREND, SLB (1W: -5.49% | 1M: +3.24%) CORRECTION, TMUS (1W: -4.82% | 1M: -8.33%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in consumer discretionary and select defensives/energy.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: NEM (1W: +14.78%), INTC (1W: +14.24%), FCX (1W: +9.94%) — note MAJOR divergence among large caps: AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META show 1W bounces vs 1M declines, implying tactical moves not yet broad structural break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is rotating with many mega-caps in RECOVERY: AAPL (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.51%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -7.83%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: +3.59% | 1M: -3.08%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +5.29% | 1M: -2.36%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +4.92% | 1M: -13.89%) RECOVERY while INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND lead pockets of strength; sector breadth positive (Technology contributing to rotation).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials showing selective strength: JPM (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -1.60%) RECOVERY while V (1W: -1.55% | 1M: -6.14%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND; overall sector up on the week supporting rotation into cyclicals and banks.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare mixed but constructive on the week: JNJ (1W: +1.59% | 1M: -0.92%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: +3.44% | 1M: -4.30%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: +4.30% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY, PFE (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +6.39%) ABOVE TREND — sector breadth positive with idiosyncratic news drivers.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials, Materials and select Industrials on rotation; reduce exposure to Consumer Discretionary and Energy where weekly weakness is concentrated. Monitor mega-cap tech RECOVERYs for confirmation before treating them as structural leaders.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +14.24% | 1M: +10.53%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +7.64%) ABOVE TREND, CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%) CORRECTION, XOM (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +7.26%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Real Estate (CCI/PLD) and Materials (NEM/FCX) on cluster strength — breadth supportive. BEARISH: Energy and Consumer Discretionary remain at risk if weekly pullbacks persist; watch for further sector rotation into cyclicals.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch whether INTC and AMD sustain their 1M gains to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; NVDA/mega-cap tech must extend weekly RECOVERY into a multi-week advance to shift leadership; CVX/XOM failing to reclaim their 1M uptrend would signal deeper Energy rotation risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
CCI (+70): CCI (1W: +8.73% | 1M: -5.83%) RECOVERY — news of sale talks confirms price strength. MSFT (+50): MSFT (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -7.83%) RECOVERY — $10bn AI investment headline confirms tactical accumulation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
NKE (-50): NKE (1W: -15.13% | 1M: -24.64%) BELOW TREND — price and negative sentiment confirm distribution. HD (-50): HD (1W: -2.07% | 1M: -12.28%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines align with price weakness. CVX (-55): CVX (1W: -4.24% | 1M: +6.96%) CORRECTION — bearish chatter while 1M remains up signals trend exhaustion.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Growth/Momentum style on evidence of tech mega-cap RECOVERYs alongside cyclical/material strength. INTC ABOVE TREND, AMD ABOVE TREND and CCI RECOVERY are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among mega-caps (1W up vs 1M down) and mixed sentiment in healthcare/tech that could keep leadership unstable; monitor news-confirmed names for follow-through.
